name: neural
description: Graph + community clustering (Louvain, base dep) + opt-in neural rerank (TF-IDF + LogisticRegression, `pip install revien[neural]`) + semantic layer. Fully LOCAL/zero-egress. A missing semantic extra aborts the bench (exit 3) unless --allow-degraded; neural rerank falls back to base scoring when its extra is absent; clustering uses the base networkx Louvain backend.
